decisions.reason: The existing message-208 DEFER already captures that decorative lighting will not be executed during immediate functional-prototype completion. Deferral does not invalidate the previously specified LED-selection approach.
The existing message-208 MODIFY and RESUME already capture the functional-prototype priority, later cosmetic refinement, and demonstration-before-completion sequence.

The existing message-208 MODIFY already records that additional branding refinement will likely occur separately after receipt of the functional prototype; the source does not revoke existing placard specifications.
Prioritizing completion with the approved component set does not change the finalized system-layout or CAD specifications.
The source discusses completing remaining physical wiring after demonstration, not changing the finalized wiring-plan deliverable.
The existing message-208 DEFER and MODIFY already capture postponement of the broader visual refinement and its timing after receipt of the functional prototype.

The existing message-208 MODIFY already records that additional DJ-style control and measurement refinements will likely occur later. The source does not revoke the existing control-detail specifications and expressly leaves K button markings under consideration.
Deferral of decorative LED selection and retention of the approved component set do not change the matcha-whisk configuration.
The existing message-208 MODIFY already captures that remaining base fabrication follows the normal-use demonstration; no platform dimension or functional specification changes.
The component-selection decision does not alter the machine's maintenance and service-access requirements.
The source postpones additional cosmetic refinement but does not change or remove the already selected beige-and-green color specifications.
The component-selection and cosmetic-timing decision does not change the required bowl-removal, swapping, or cleaning behavior.
